CustomImage.title: Custom Image
CustomImage.description: Stores custom images for products and the site banner.

id.description: The unique identifier for the image (e.g., product ID or 'banner').

url.description: The base64 data URL of the custom image.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the image was last updated.

ProductDetail.title: Product Detail
ProductDetail.description: Stores detailed text information for each product.

id.description: The unique identifier for the product.

text.description: The detailed text content for the product.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the details were last updated.

CalorieScan.title: Calorie Scan
CalorieScan.description: Stores nutritional analysis of food images.

/custom_images/{imageId}.description: Collection of custom images indexed by their ID.

/product_details/{productId}.description: Collection of detailed product information indexed by product ID.

/calorie_scans/{scanId}.description: Collection of nutritional scans performed by users.
